text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, meaning sex was not a factor in distinguishing between you. An all-female panel choosing one female applicant over another provides no factual or legal basis for a claim of sex discrimination. 

The hiring decision likely came down to institutional priorities: the municipality may have valued extensive public consultation and stakeholder engagement over technical credentials and tenure. Raising the gender composition of the panel would appear unfounded, harm your professional reputation, and burn bridges within the municipal sector. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused on what skills or experiences the municipality prioritized, framed around your ongoing professional development.
